selection: 10 eligible examples per category; Python random.Random(sft-review-v1:<category>)
reviewer: Codex qualitative review; not independent human fact-checking
decision: Restrict the first SFT run to classification and passage-based tasks after finding factual errors, vague answers and question/answer mismatches in the sampled context-free QA. This does not certify every retained label.

exclusion_reasons.1184: Unnecessary questionable club attribution in a sports answer.
exclusion_reasons.1521: Ambiguous request about superiority over predecessor and successor; answer does not establish both.
exclusion_reasons.3030: Oversimplified and misleading dominant/recessive account of hair colour.
exclusion_reasons.4417: Vague normative response unsuitable as an objective target.
exclusion_reasons.6420: Answers a comparison with friendship instead of the requested affection.
exclusion_reasons.6677: Broad regulatory assertion without a consistently scoped jurisdiction.
exclusion_reasons.6901: Policy-dependent numerical limit without an as-of date.
exclusion_reasons.10035: Drops the position exception explicitly present in the supplied passage.
exclusion_reasons.13518: Definition confuses sounds and positions in alliteration.

limitations: Only 60 sampled examples were qualitatively inspected.
The review is not a factual audit of all records.
Lexical grouping does not remove every semantic duplicate.
Classification examples often repeat similar instruction templates.
